From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Private Offer: Nubex - GCP SKU split, rev-share & term waiver request

Team — forwarding a new private-offer request from Nubex (they're in final procurement). Key points:

- Account: Nubex Inc. (GT: cloud-native SI)
- Proposed sale via GCP Marketplace private offer (single SKU covering both Managed and Hosted tiers)
- Nubex asks for an 18% marketplace rev-share to their channel partner (one-off carveout) — our standard is 12–15% depending on tier
- Payment terms requested: Net 90 with PO up front
- Contract clause ask: limited liability cap reduced to 3x fees and a custom data residency addendum; they also asked to remove our standard indemnity for third-party IP claims (redline attached)

Attachments: Nubex_PrivateOffer_Draft_v3.pdf (private offer draft), RDW_SLA_2027_redlines.docx (their legal redlines).

Why this is urgent: Nubex is a reference target for GCP integration; finance warns that moving from Net 30 to Net 90 and an 18% rev-share will materially change unit economics for this SKU. They've committed to start onboarding in November if we can sign.

Ask: Karthik / Steph — can Deal Desk approve either the 18% carveout or an alternative structure (e.g., 15% w/ marketing co-fund)? Also need an exec signoff on any liability cap change or indemnity removal. Please advise an approvable counter by EOD 9/20 so I can respond to procurement.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Nubex - GCP SKU split, rev-share & term waiver request

Lauren — thanks for the context and attachments. Quick notes from Deal Desk review: 

1) Rev-share: 18% is outside our current marketplace band. We can approve up to 15% for strategic targets if Nubex commits to a 12-month minimum volume threshold (TBD). Alternatively, offer 15% + 50% co-marketing fund (capped).

2) Payment terms: Net 90 is high risk. Finance will require PO + deposit (20%) and we can accept Net 60 after onboarding. If procurement insists on Net 90, we need a bill-of-sale routing via Redwood Dedicated and a collections holdback in the contract.

3) Indemnity & liability cap: Legal flagged removal of indemnity as a hard no. We can consider a limited indemnity with carve-outs for pre-existing IP claims and a 3x fees cap only if legal signs off and we add a mutual covenant of non-infringement.

4) SKU/Offer structure: Splitting into two SKUs (Hosted / Managed) preserves margin visibility. If they insist on a single SKU, we need internal allocation rules for revenue recognition.

Related link: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/RDW-2027-NUBEX-47

I'll draft a counter with two options: (A) 15% rev-share + 50% co-marketing fund + Net60 w/ 20% deposit, or (B) 18% rev-share but only if minimum ARR commit and limited indemnity retained. Need exec sign-off on (B).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Deal Desk Manager
[Attachment: DealDesk_Econ_worksheet_Nubex.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Hi Lauren / team — thanks for the quick turn. A couple clarifications from procurement side (forwarding PO):

- Nubex cannot reduce the 18% channel commission — that's baked into our partner agreements and required to compensate our reseller network.
- Net 90 is non-negotiable for our finance team due to client billing cadence; we can provide an upfront PO and can discuss a 15% deposit but 20% is preferable.
- On indemnity: we can accept a limited mutual indemnity but asking Redwood to narrow the IP indemnity carve to known IP, not blanket.

Attached: Nubex_PO_4721.pdf — this is their procurement PO. We're prepared to push to GCP Marketplace onboarding if we can finalize the private offer this week.

John Park
Head of Alliances, Nubex Inc.

Marissa / Jonas — escalating for exec approval. Nubex is pushing for 18% rev-share + Net 90 and narrow indemnity. Deal Desk proposes two counters (see Karthik):

Option A (preferred by Deal Desk): 15% rev-share + 50% co-marketing fund (one-time credit) + Net60 w/ 20% deposit.
Option B (requires exec signoff): 18% rev-share + Net90 + 3x liability cap + limited indemnity language (must be approved by Legal).

Impact: Option A keeps unit economics within plan and preserves SLA and collections terms. Option B risks lower realized revenue and longer cash conversion but could unlock an important GCP reference and channel expansion. Nubex has provided PO 4721 and is ready to onboard if we finalize this week.

Request: Marissa / Jonas — do you approve Option B (with Legal to finalize limited indemnity) or should we counter with Option A? We need a decision by EOD 9/21 to hit Nubex's onboarding timeline.

Lauren

Lauren / team — after reviewing economics and strategic weighting for cloud partnerships, I will approve Option B on a conditional basis:

- Approve 18% rev-share and Net 90 only if Nubex signs a 12-month minimum ARR commitment (minimum $150k ARR), provides the PO + 20% deposit on signature, and agrees to joint press/marketing commitments (to justify the higher rev-share).
- Legal must sign off on the limited indemnity language; I want the indemnity narrowed but not removed. No blanket IP removals.
- Finance to add an escrow-style collections holdback for first 90 days of invoices to mitigate cash risk.

Karthik / Legal / Finance — please draft the exact counter language and routing for signature. Lauren — inform Nubex we provisionally approve Option B subject to the items above and ask them to confirm the ARR commitment in writing.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
